mentions.name: Mockingjay
mentions.description: An iOS app that records video and streams AES-256-GCM encrypted chunks to Google Drive in real time, so footage is already secured in the cloud by the time someone takes the phone. Includes a duress PIN that wipes local keys while preserving cloud backups and a fake sleep mode that makes the phone appear powered off during recording.
mentions.problem: If someone takes your phone, locally recorded footage can be lost or destroyed before it can be shared.
mentions.audience: Journalists, activists, and anyone who needs tamper-proof evidence.
mentions.source_excerpt: Mockingjay ( https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758616261 ) — iOS app that records video and streams AES-256-GCM encrypted chunks to your Google Drive in real-time. By the time someone takes your phone, the footage is already safe in the cloud. Built for journalists, activists, and anyone who needs tamper-proof evidence. Features a duress PIN that wipes local keys while preserving cloud backups, and a fake sleep mode that makes the phone look powered off during recording.
